glosses: An animal which is able to consume both plants (like a herbivore) and meat (like a carnivore).

examples.text: Bears are omnivores: they can eat plants, but they also eat fish.

glosses: Qui mange de tout.

examples.text: Le chimpanzé est omnivore, et il est occasionnellement carnivore. Il pratique occasionnellement la chasse.
